stem: What is the BEST way to combine sentences 21 and 22?

options.label: A
options.text: Sucking up carbon dioxide and producing large amounts of oxygen are how this seagrass is like the rain forest.

options.label: B
options.text: This seagrass is like the rain forest that sucks up carbon dioxide that produces large amounts of oxygen.

options.label: C
options.text: Although this seagrass sucks up carbon dioxide and produces large amounts of oxygen, the seagrass is like the rain forest.

options.label: D
options.text: Like the rain forest, this seagrass sucks up carbon dioxide and produces large amounts of oxygen.
